rdfs:Class.rdfs:label: Variable Container
rdfs:Class.rdfs:comment: Instances of this class can hold a list of variables. Subclasses are qel:Query and qel:ResultSet.

rdfs:Class.rdfs:label: Query Literal Container
rdfs:Class.rdfs:comment: Instances of this class can have a body. Subclasses are qel:Query and qel:Rule.

rdfs:Class.rdfs:label: QEL Query
rdfs:Class.rdfs:comment: Instances of this class are QEL queries.

rdfs:Class.rdfs:label: Variable
rdfs:Class.rdfs:comment: Instances of this class are variables in a query.

rdf:Property.rdfs:label: Result variables
rdf:Property.rdfs:comment: A list of variables that are used in a result.

rdf:Property.rdfs:label: Literal
rdf:Property.rdfs:comment: A non-outer join query literal in the body of a rule or a query.

rdf:Property.rdfs:label: Outer join literal
rdf:Property.rdfs:comment: An outer join query literal in the body of a rule or a query.

rdfs:Class.rdfs:label: Query Literal
rdfs:Class.rdfs:comment: Instances of this class are query literals.

rdfs:Class.rdfs:label: Statement Literal
rdfs:Class.rdfs:comment: Instances of this class are RDF statement literals, using the 's' datalog predicate.

rdf:Property.rdfs:label: Arguments
rdf:Property.rdfs:comment: The arguments of a query literal.

rdfs:Class.rdfs:label: Predicate
rdfs:Class.rdfs:comment: Instances of this class are predicates.

rdfs:Class.rdfs:label: Built-in predicate
rdfs:Class.rdfs:comment: Instances of this class are built-in predicates.

rdfs:Class.rdfs:label: Rule
rdfs:Class.rdfs:comment: Instances of this class are rules.

rdf:Property.rdfs:label: Negated
rdf:Property.rdfs:comment: Whether a query literal is negated or not. Note that only built-in predicates can be negated.

qel:BuiltinPredicate.rdfs:label: Equals
qel:BuiltinPredicate.rdfs:comment: Predicate used to compare two strings.

qel:BuiltinPredicate.rdfs:label: Like
qel:BuiltinPredicate.rdfs:comment: Predicate used to test if a string contains another string as a substring.

qel:BuiltinPredicate.rdfs:label: Less than
qel:BuiltinPredicate.rdfs:comment: Predicate to compare two strings numerically.

qel:BuiltinPredicate.rdfs:label: Greater than
qel:BuiltinPredicate.rdfs:comment: Predicate to compare two strings numerically.

qel:BuiltinPredicate.rdfs:label: Node type
qel:BuiltinPredicate.rdfs:comment: Predicate to test the RDF node type of a node.

qel:BuiltinPredicate.rdfs:label: Language
qel:BuiltinPredicate.rdfs:comment: Predicate to test the language of an RDF literal.

qel:BuiltinPredicate.rdfs:label: Data type
qel:BuiltinPredicate.rdfs:comment: Predicate to test the data type of an RDF literal.

rdfs:Class.rdfs:label: Node type
rdfs:Class.rdfs:comment: Instances of this class are RDF node types.

rdfs:Class.rdfs:label: Result set
rdfs:Class.rdfs:comment: Instances of this class are QEL result sets.

rdf:Property.rdfs:label: Query
rdf:Property.rdfs:comment: The query belonging to a result set.

rdf:Property.rdfs:label: Result
rdf:Property.rdfs:comment: A result belonging to a result set.

rdfs:Class.rdfs:label: QEL implementation
rdfs:Class.rdfs:comment: Instances of this class are QEL implementations.

rdf:Property.rdfs:label: Supports complexity
rdf:Property.rdfs:comment: The complexity that an implementation supports for non-outer join queries.

rdf:Property.rdfs:label: Supports outer join complexity
rdf:Property.rdfs:comment: The complexity that an implementation supports for outer join queries.

qel:Complexity.rdfs:label: Linear recursive queries
qel:Complexity.rdfs:comment: The complexity of linear recursive queries.

qel:Complexity.rdfs:label: General recursive queries
qel:Complexity.rdfs:comment: The complexity of general recursive queries.

rdf:Property.rdfs:label: Supports built-in predicate
rdf:Property.rdfs:comment: A built-in predicate that the implementation supports.

rdf:Property.rdfs:label: Supports negation
rdf:Property.rdfs:comment: Whether the implementation supports negation of built-in predicates.
